candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Izdana dovoljenja Banke Slovenije (issued authorisations incl. management-board and supervisory-board fit-and-proper approvals)
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-authority primary record of leadership moves in Slovenian banks and savings banks: a filterable table of issued authorisations grouped into four categories, of which two are explicitly 'Dovoljenja za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave banke in hranilnice' and 'Dovoljenja za opravljanje funkcije člana nadzornega sveta banke in hranilnice' (ZBan-3 art. 309), plus qualified-holdings and banking-services authorisations. Table observed with ~147 entries carrying dates, person names and the institution concerned — i.e. a structured, name-level, dated log of board appointments approved by the supervisor.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scrape of the filterable table (check for an underlying JSON/XHR endpoint behind the filters); diff on (date, person, institution, authorisation type) to emit new-appointment events.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for the statutory consent term, then direct fetch of the regulator page

candidates.why_relevant: Corroborating and often faster-than-supervisor record of who is a registered representative (zastopnik), board member or supervisory-body member of a Slovenian bank, payment institution or insurer, plus the eObjave stream of court-register entries. candidates.source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – fit-and-proper framework and significance/supervised-entity lists covering Slovenian SIs
candidates.why_relevant: For Slovenia's significant institutions (e.g. NLB, and groups classified as among the three largest supervised groups in Slovenia), fit-and-proper decisions are legally ECB decisions, not Banka Slovenije ones. Missing this source would create a systematic blind spot precisely at the largest banks. ECB publishes the Guide to fit and proper assessments and the annual significance assessment / supervised-entity lists, and BS mirrors procedure descriptions at /en/banking-supervision/supervisory-practices-procedures-and-measures.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the annual list of supervised entities and the significance assessment PDFs; treat individual F&P decisions as generally NOT published at person level — expect to reconstruct SI-bank board changes from issuer/company disclosures instead.

Without this the collection pipeline cannot tell a legally mandated disclosure from an optional one, nor anticipate where a new publication duty will appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to fix the publication-duty map; then watch PISRS for amendments to ZBan-3 / ZZavar-1 / ZPlaSSIED that change board-approval publication requirements.

negative_findings.description: No standalone UJP careers/vacancy page was found on ujp.gov.si or the UJP GOV.SI institution page; UJP postings appear to be routed through the central gov.si vacancy register and are mirrored by aggregators such as Optius.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Slovenian for UJP vacancies and director competitions returned the institution profile, Bizi/e-uprava directory entries and an Optius employer page, but no UJP-hosted vacancy list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for UJP must be built on institution-filtered queries against gov.si/zbirke/delovna-mesta rather than on a UJP-specific crawler; assuming a dedicated page would silently produce zero events.

negative_findings.description: It could not be established that ATVP or AZN publish individual fit-and-proper decisions (odločbe о dovoljenju za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave) at person level, the way Banka Slovenije clearly does in its issued-authorisations table.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language searches surfaced ATVP application forms (VPR questionnaires for BPD/DZU board members) and AZN suitability-assessment guidance, plus firm-level registers, but no person-level decision list for either agency.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move coverage on the capital-markets and insurance sides may be structurally thinner than on the banking side; the pipeline should not assume parity across the three supervisors and should plan an AJPES/company-disclosure fallback or an ZDIJZ request.

negative_findings.description: No published person-level ECB/SSM fit-and-proper decision list for Slovenian significant institutions was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-language searching returned only the SSM Guide to fit and proper assessments, significance-assessment reports and O-SII notifications; confirmed that F&P decisions for significant institutions are legally ECB decisions, but with no individual-decision publication surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Board changes at Slovenia's largest banks (the ECB-supervised ones, e.g. NLB) will not appear in the Banka Slovenije authorisations table, creating a blind spot exactly where the market impact is greatest.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or API feed was identified for the vacancy pages of Banka Slovenije, ATVP or AZN.
negative_findings.result_summary: The AZN vacancy page was fetched directly and offers only an HTML list with per-post PDFs plus a 'Novičnik' newsletter; the BS careers hub shows no feed; ATVP publishes vacancies as ordinary news items.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be polling-and-diff based with PDF extraction, which raises maintenance cost and means posting-removal (after a deadline) can destroy the record unless snapshots are stored.

negative_findings.description: The ATVP vacancy URL contains an opaque generated path segment (/ID6lNM3Jl6T4gfNt/prosta-delovna-mesta) and ATVP content is served from two hostnames (a-tvp.si and atvp.si).
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed in search results; not fetched by me, so liveness is unverified. A future 404 on this path would be a hypothesis of relocation, not evidence the page is gone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hardcoding this URL is fragile; the collector should resolve the vacancy page from the site menu each run and treat both hostnames as one source.

negative_findings.description: https://www.bsi.si/razpisi/kadrovski-razpisi was cited inside Banka Slovenije job adverts as the canonical application address but was not itself fetched in this pass; the BS careers hub did not expose an explicit link to it.
negative_findings.result_summary: Path known only from advert text and search snippets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is the likely primary vacancy endpoint for the central bank; it must be resolved by the deterministic liveness pass before being wired into collection, with apl.bsi.si/zaposlitev.asp as the confirmed fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: ECB-supervised significant institutions in Slovenia are outside the national fit-and-proper publication channel, and no substitute person-level source was established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a complementary lane covering issuer disclosures (Ljubljana Stock Exchange / SEOnet), company press releases and annual-report governance sections for the SI significant institutions, and treat Banka Slovenije's table as covering less-significant institutions only.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment institutions and e-money institutions: their management-body approvals by Banka Slovenije were not confirmed to be published in the same way as bank board authorisations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect the ZPlaSSIED registers and each entity's register page for board/representative fields, and check whether the issued-authorisations table has a payments category; otherwise fall back to AJPES ePRS person-level lookups against the payments-register actor list.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical archive of removed vacancy postings was identified for any of the three supervisors; expired posts appear to be deleted rather than archived.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every vacancy page and PDF at collection time into the run store, and back-fill history from web.archive.org for BS, ATVP and AZN vacancy URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent Slovenian bodies that also generate financial-sector leadership and organisational events were not covered in this cell: SDH (state asset manager, appoints supervisory boards of state-owned banks/insurers), the Bank Assets Management Company successor arrangements, the deposit-guarantee and resolution functions, and the Ministry of Finance's directorate for the financial system.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell or open an adjacent cell for SDH nomination/appointment announcements and the MF Direktorat za finančni sistem, both of which drive board composition at state-linked banks and insurers.

coverage_gaps.description: Internal reorganisation of the supervisors is only weakly observable — inferred from unit names in vacancy adverts and from org-chart pages, with no announced change log.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot the ATVP organisational-structure page, the AZN organisation pages and the BS FOI catalogue quarterly and diff them; supplement with the annual reports (letno poročilo) of BS, ATVP and AZN, which typically state headcount and organisational changes.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of these sources is partial: BS and GOV.SI maintain /en/ mirrors, but ATVP, AZN and Uradni list appointment decisions are effectively Slovenian-only.

brief: Slovenia's supervisory layer splits cleanly into three publication regimes for leadership moves. Banka Slovenije is the strongest: its 'Izdana dovoljenja' table publishes dated, name-level authorisations for bank and savings-bank management and supervisory board members under ZBan-3, alongside qualified-holdings and services authorisations, and it maintains statutory registers for payment and e-money institutions. ATVP and AZN are legally the fit-and-proper authorities for investment firms, fund managers and insurers, but only their application forms, guidance and firm-level registers were confirmed public — person-level decisions were not, so those sides likely need AJPES ePRS and issuer disclosures as fallbacks. As employers, all four bodies plus the Ministry of Finance and UJP are well covered: AZN and ATVP post vacancies on their own sites (AZN confirmed live with three dated Aug-2026 posts), Banka Slovenije uses its kadrovski-razpisi application and the legacy apl.bsi.si endpoint, and the central gov.si vacancy register carries ministry, UJP and even agency-director competitions, while the very top appointments (governor, Council members) run through the President's nomination, the National Assembly vote and a Sklep o imenovanju in Uradni list.
